fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior and Sold Post without consideration are not assigned prices.
Withdrawn Prior and Withdrawn Post are not represented as completed sales or current availability.
Unreadable official update endpoints are not reconstructed or guessed.
Historic lease, AST and licence periods are not silently extended to current occupation.
Future RPI, CPI and open-market reviews are not treated as current rent.
Conditional GBP1 freehold options are not represented as exercised.
Holding-over income is not represented as a secure fixed term.
Vacant possession and vacant suites are not represented as income-producing occupation.
Planning consent, potential and indicative schemes are not represented as implemented or valued outcomes.
Peppercorn, substation and residential ground rents remain separate from occupational income.
Dissolved or administrated tenant evidence prevents historical headline rent from being treated as current collectible income.
Active company status, charges and guarantees do not imply covenant strength or property-level performance.
